reports.title: Amdocs Limited Reports Fourth Quarter Fiscal 2026 Results & Full Year Fiscal 2026 Results

guidance.heading: First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Outlook
section:
Revenue | $955-$995
GAAP Diluted earnings per share | $0.81-$0.89
Non-GAAP Diluted earnings per share | $1.27-$1.33
• | First quarter revenue guidance assumes a positive $1 million sequential impact from foreign currency fluctuations as compared to the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026
• | GAAP diluted EPS guidance does not include: the impact of future restructuring charges; the impact of the acquisition of EIS; and the impact of the divestiture of Vubiquity

• | First quarter non-GAAP diluted EPS guidance excludes primarily equity-based compensation expense of approximately $0.24-$0.26 per share, amortization of purchased intangible assets and other acquisition-related costs of approximately $0.17 per share, changes in certain acquisitions related liabilities measured at fair value, and other, net of related tax effects.

Revenue Growth, as reported | (17.9%)-(14.3%)
Revenue growth, pro forma(2) constant currency(1) | (11%)-(7%)
GAAP Diluted earnings per share | (25%)-(17%)
Non-GAAP Diluted earnings per share | (30%)-(26%)
Free Cash Flow (3) | $440-$500

• | Full year fiscal 2027 revenue guidance takes into consideration best estimates to reflect the legal dispute with T-Mobile as of this date, including in case of termination of agreements with T-Mobile by either party

• | Full year fiscal 2027 revenue guidance incorporates an expected negative impact from foreign currency fluctuations of approximately 0.1% year-over-year, and includes some inorganic contribution, including the acquisition of EIS

• | Revenue growth on a pro forma(2) constant currency(1) basis adjusts fiscal 2026 revenue by approximately $360 million to reflect the exit of non-strategic business activities relating to the resale of hardware activities, and the divestiture of the media business; these actions were substantially already taken in the first quarter of fiscal 2027
• | GAAP diluted EPS guidance does not include: the impact of future restructuring charges; the impact of the acquisition of EIS; and the impact of the divestiture of Vubiquity

• | Non-GAAP diluted earnings per share growth excludes primarily equity-based compensation expense of approximately $0.84-$0.92 per share, amortization of purchased intangible assets and other acquisition-related costs of approximately $0.61 per share, changes in certain acquisitions related liabilities measured at fair value, and other, net of related tax effects
